name: 7-Game Series
description: Every week is a best-of-7 playoff series. Win the day by finishing your lineup.

APP_URL.description: This app's public origin, used in sign-in emails, e.g. https://my-7gs.herokuapp.com

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender for sign-in emails, e.g. 7-Game Series <play@yourdomain.com> (a domain verified with your email provider).

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key (or use POSTMARK_API_TOKEN instead).

POSTMARK_API_TOKEN.description: Postmark server token (or use RESEND_API_KEY instead).

ALLOW_DEV_LOGIN.description: true = skip email and show a 'Sign in now' button. Private trials only: anyone can sign in as any address.
